response.title: Spotify Premium Family - Spotify (UK)
response.markdown:
Spotify Premium Family - Spotify (UK)

 

-   -   Play offline. Listen anywhere.
    -   Ad-free music listening. Enjoy non-stop music.
    -   15 hours/month of listening time from our audiobooks subscriber catalogue (plan manager only).
    -   Unlimited skips. Just press next.
    -   Up to 6 accounts.
    
-   -   Music
    -   Playlists
    -   Recommendations
    -   Audiobooks you’ve purchased
    

-   Sign up or log in with your existing account.
    
-   Invite family members you live with to Premium, and create accounts for your young listeners.
    
-   Family members accept the invitation at home, confirm their address and that’s it – you’re part of the family. \*
    

\* Family plan members must live at the same address to join Premium Family.

-   Do we share an account, or do we each get our own?
    
    Every family member invited to Premium Family gets their own Premium account, so you can each play your own music whenever you want. And because you now have separate accounts, music recommendations are tailored to your individual tastes.
    
-   How do I create an account for a listener under 13 years old?
    
    Family members under 13 years old can be added to your Family plan through managed accounts. When you’re adding plan members, choose the “Add a listener under 13” option. This creates a managed account on your plan. Managed accounts allow young listeners to have a music-only Premium account, where you decide what they’re allowed to listen to. You can manage playback of videos, content that’s labelled as explicit and even remove specific artists and songs.
    
-   I’m already on Premium. What happens to all my saved music?
    
    You can upgrade to Family with your existing Premium account and keep all your saved music, playlists and recommendations.
    
-   How does the bill work? Do we split the cost?
    
    The person who purchases Family will receive a single bill of £21.99 every month.
    
-   Can we only listen at home?
    
    You can listen to Spotify anywhere you want, on any device.
    
-   How does audiobook listening time work for plan managers and plan members on Premium Family plans?
    
    With a Premium Family plan, the plan manager has access to 15 hours of audiobook listening time per month. Unused listening hours expire at the end of each month and do not carry over. The audiobook subscriber catalogue includes over 700,000 titles across many genres and classics. The Family plan manager has audiobook listening time included in the plan. Plan members can get audiobook listening time with an add-on. Learn more about Premium Family.
